itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Ijen Crater Blue Fire & Sunrise Adventure

items.text: Your adventure begins with an early-morning pick-up by our Ijen tour team from your preferred location in Banyuwangi, including your hotel, homestay, bus terminal, train station, or ferry port. From there, we will travel to Paltuding Post, the main starting point for the Mount Ijen hike, which is approximately one hour away from Banyuwangi City.

Once we arrive at Paltuding, you will have time to enjoy a warm cup of coffee or tea while preparing for the hike. Before setting off, our local guide will provide a safety briefing and explain the route, trail conditions, and important guidelines to ensure a safe and enjoyable trekking experience.

At approximately 02:00 AM, we will begin the ascent toward the Ijen Crater summit. The hiking trail covers around 3.4 km one way and generally takes 1.5–2 hours, depending on your walking pace and physical condition. Along the route, you will pass several checkpoints, with small local stalls available at various points where you can pause briefly and catch your breath.

After reaching the upper crater area, we will continue toward the Blue Fire viewing area. This section involves a steep descent over rocky and potentially slippery terrain, taking approximately 30 minutes or longer depending on trail conditions. With the guidance of our experienced local guide, you will have the opportunity to witness the extraordinary blue flames produced by the combustion of sulfuric gases, a rare natural spectacle that makes Ijen one of Indonesia's most remarkable destinations. Access to the crater floor depends on official regulations, weather, volcanic activity, and safety conditions.

Once you have enjoyed this unique natural phenomenon, we will make our way back toward the crater rim and proceed to a suitable sunrise viewpoint. As the first light of day appears, take in the breathtaking scenery of Ijen's striking turquoise crater lake, surrounded by dramatic volcanic landscapes. This is also the perfect opportunity to capture memorable photographs of one of East Java's most iconic natural wonders.

After spending time enjoying the panoramic views and morning atmosphere, we will descend along the same hiking trail to Paltuding Post, usually arriving around 06:00–07:00 AM, depending on the pace of the group and trail conditions. You can take a short break before our team transfers you back to your accommodation or the agreed drop-off point in Banyuwangi.

overview: Escape the ordinary and discover a different side of East Java through an unforgettable journey into the wilderness of Meru Betiri National Park. This two-day adventure takes you deep into tropical forests, across rugged off-road trails and river crossings, and into the peaceful coastal village of Sukamade, one of the natural habitats of sea turtles.

Beyond the thrill of the journey, experience the beauty of nature up close, witness the remarkable nesting behavior of sea turtles at night, and take part in releasing baby turtles, locally known as tukik, back into the ocean when conditions and conservation activities permit.
From the untouched atmosphere of Sukamade to the coastal charm of Pulau Merah, this trip combines wildlife encounters, local experiences, and an exciting 4WD journey into one memorable adventure.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Banyuwangi City – Off-Road Journey to Sukamade

items.text: A Journey Through Plantations, Tropical Forests & Untouched Wilderness

Your adventure begins with a pick-up from your hotel, train station, or another agreed meeting point within Banyuwangi City. Meet your local team, receive a short introduction to the journey, and get ready to explore the remote landscapes of southern Banyuwangi aboard a rugged 4WD vehicle.

As we leave the city behind, the scenery gradually changes from local settlements and countryside roads to expansive plantations of cocoa, rubber, and other tropical crops. Along the way, enjoy glimpses of rural life before entering the greener and more secluded surroundings of Meru Betiri National Park.

The journey becomes increasingly adventurous as the vehicle navigates winding forest tracks, uneven terrain, muddy paths, and river crossings, depending on the weather and road conditions. Every turn reveals a different view of the rainforest, making the journey itself an essential part of the experience.

Upon reaching Sukamade, a quiet coastal area surrounded by tropical vegetation, we will check in at a simple eco-lodge. Take some time to settle in, enjoy the peaceful surroundings, and recharge before the evening's main activity.
Evening Experience | Sea Turtle Nesting Tour

After dinner, prepare for a guided night excursion to Sukamade Beach, a well-known nesting area for sea turtles. Accompanied by local guides and following the conservation team's instructions, you will have the opportunity to learn about the nesting process and, if nature allows, observe a female sea turtle coming ashore to lay her eggs.

Experience the remarkable atmosphere of the beach at night, where the sound of the waves and the darkness of the coastline create a truly special wildlife encounter. The activity is conducted with respect for the turtles and their natural habitat, so visitors must follow the guide's instructions regarding distance, lighting, photography, and movement.

Sea turtle sightings are never guaranteed, as the activity depends on natural conditions and the animals' behavior. However, the opportunity to explore this protected coastal environment makes the experience memorable in its own right.
After the excursion, return to the lodge and enjoy a well-deserved rest surrounded by the sounds of nature.
Overnight: Sukamade Eco-Lodge (basic accommodation)
Main Experiences: 4WD off-road adventure, cocoa and rubber plantations, rainforest exploration, river crossings, and a guided sea turtle nesting excursion.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Sukamade Beach – Turtle Conservation Experience – Pulau Merah – Banyuwangi City

items.text: From Wildlife Encounters to the Beautiful Southern Coast
Wake up early and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of Sukamade before beginning the morning's conservation-related activity.
Morning Experience | Baby Turtle Release

If a release session is scheduled and baby turtles are available, join a guided activity to release young sea turtles, known locally as tukik, into the ocean. Watch as these tiny creatures make their first journey toward the sea, an inspiring moment that highlights the importance of protecting marine wildlife and preserving coastal ecosystems.

The activity depends on hatchling availability, conservation schedules, weather, and local regulations. The release is supervised by local conservation personnel, and participants must follow all instructions to minimize disturbance to the animals.
After the activity, return to the lodge for breakfast. Enjoy your final moments in Sukamade, pack your belongings, and complete the check-out process before continuing the journey.
Late Morning | Off-Road Journey Out of Sukamade

Board the 4WD vehicle once again and travel back through the forest tracks of Meru Betiri National Park. The return journey offers another opportunity to appreciate the surrounding rainforest, plantation landscapes, and remote countryside.
Road conditions can affect the travel time, so the schedule may be adjusted to ensure a safe and comfortable journey.
Midday to Afternoon | Visit Pulau Merah (Red Island)
Continue toward Pulau Merah, one of Banyuwangi's best-known coastal destinations, recognized for its broad sandy beach, scenic coastline, and distinctive reddish hill near the shore.

Upon arrival, enjoy time to relax by the beach, admire the ocean views, or take photographs of the surrounding landscape. For guests interested in surfing, a surfboard rental is included in the package, subject to local availability and suitable sea conditions.
Whether you prefer enjoying the coastal scenery or trying a few waves, Pulau Merah provides a refreshing contrast to the dense forests and remote wilderness of Sukamade.
Guests are encouraged to follow local safety advice before entering the water, especially when waves or currents are strong.
Afternoon | Return to Banyuwangi City

After enjoying the beach, we will begin the return journey to Banyuwangi City. Sit back and relax as the scenery transitions from the southern coastline and countryside to the more developed areas of the city.
The tour concludes with a drop-off at your preferred location within Banyuwangi City, which can include:
Your hotel or accommodation in Banyuwangi City

Transfer to Borobudur Temple
Enjoy the early morning drive through the peaceful landscapes of Central Java as you make your way to the magnificent Borobudur Temple.
Explore Borobudur Temple

Discover the beauty of Borobudur, a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its remarkable Buddhist architecture, intricate stone carvings, and rich cultural heritage. Enjoy time to explore the temple, admire its impressive structures, and capture memorable photographs.
Transfer to Prambanan Temple
Continue your journey to Prambanan Temple, enjoying a scenic drive to another of Indonesia’s most extraordinary historical landmarks.

items.text: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure through the hidden natural wonders of Yogyakarta! This full-day experience combines the breathtaking underground beauty of Jomblang Cave, the unique river cave exploration of Pindul Cave, and an exciting tubing adventure along the Oyo River.
07:00 AM – Hotel Pickup in Yogyakarta
Your adventure begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel in Yogyakarta city, followed by a scenic drive to Jomblang Cave Basecamp.
Arrival at Jomblang Cave Basecamp

Upon arrival, you will receive a safety briefing and instructions from the local team. Get equipped with the necessary safety gear before preparing to descend into the spectacular underground world of Jomblang Cave.
Explore Jomblang Cave

Experience the thrill of descending into one of Indonesia’s most extraordinary vertical caves. Explore its ancient underground forest and witness the magical Light of Heaven, where sunlight streams through the cave opening, creating a breathtaking natural spectacle.
Return to the Surface & Lunch
After completing your cave exploration, you will be lifted back to the main ground. Take a break and enjoy lunch at the basecamp before continuing to your next destination.
Transfer to Pindul Cave Basecamp
Continue your journey to Pindul Cave, another remarkable natural attraction known for its underground river and unique cave formations.
Pindul Cave Tubing Adventure

After a safety briefing and equipment preparation, begin your tubing adventure through Pindul Cave. Float along the underground river on an inner tube while admiring the impressive stalactites, stalagmites, and fascinating rock formations inside the cave.
Oyo River Tubing Adventure

The adventure continues at Oyo River, where you will enjoy a scenic tubing experience surrounded by limestone cliffs and lush natural landscapes. Depending on the river conditions, you may also have the opportunity to experience small waterfalls and refreshing natural pools along the way.
Return to Basecamp
After completing both tubing adventures, return to the basecamp to freshen up and prepare for your journey back to the city.
Drive Back to Yogyakarta City
Relax during the return drive after a full day of exploration and adventure.
Drop-off in Yogyakarta City
Your trip concludes with a drop-off at your preferred location in Yogyakarta city, leaving you with unforgettable memories of the region’s incredible underground landscapes and natural beauty.
